description: This file is a Java class providing a wrapper for REST API interactions in tests, including methods for authenticated and unauthenticated requests and URL construction.

classes.name: OrangeHrmApi
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for constructing API requests with authentication, unauthenticated requests, and URL building for testing purposes.

methods.name: authed
methods.description: Builds a REST Assured request specification with authentication, using bearer token if available or cookies otherwise.

methods.name: anon
methods.description: Creates a REST Assured request specification for unauthenticated requests.

methods.name: v2
methods.description: Generates a full API URL for version 2 endpoints based on a relative resource path.
